name: XeedQ
description: XeedQ develops quantum processors based on spin qubits in diamond, producing compact, energy-efficient solid-state quantum computers. Awarded EUR 30 million by the DLR Quantum Computing Initiative, the company aims to deliver a 32-qubit fault-tolerant system by 2026 and 256+ qubit mobile processors by 2028.

sources.title: DLR awards 30 million Euros to XeedQ
